title: Guard .gitignore sync with fast test rather than CI round-trip discovery
context: One-sided edit of ENTRIES (added .hunch/events.log) without updating OVERLAY_IGNORE caused silent CI failure after 7 minutes with an opaque hash error. No local test caught it.
decision: Added test asserting OVERLAY_IGNORE equals runtime-generated .gitignore byte-for-byte, catching drift locally in 25ms rather than after 7-minute CI run.
consequences: One-sided synchronization errors fail immediately in development, not in CI
The dual-source-of-truth invariant is explicit and tested
Debug cycle time reduced from 7 minutes to 25ms
Future edits must satisfy the test or fail fast
alternatives_rejected: Just fix the one entry and rely on CI to catch future mismatches
Auto-generate OVERLAY_IGNORE from ENTRIES (requires architectural refactor)
Keep manual synchronization without test coverage

rejected_tripwires.alternative: Just fix the one entry and rely on CI to catch future mismatches
